title: Diode laser for harvesting de-epithelialized palatal graft in the treatment of gingival recession defects: A randomized clinical trial
authors: Ozcelik O, Seydaoglu G, Haytac CM. 2016. J Clin Periodontol.; 43(1):63-71. * Jason® fleece
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “While both techniques were effective in regard to root coverage at 6 -months, the DGG-L technique decreased post-operative morbidity associated with palatal donor-site surgery” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
